purpose: Synthetic examples and required conformance scenarios; no execution or backend-completion claim.

steps: Start mailbox A request
Switch to mailbox B and increment request generation
Resolve A success or error
scenarios.expect: Neither response nor error mutates B state.

steps: Start actor A request
Replace context with session_b
Resolve A success or 401
scenarios.expect: No A data appears and old A 401 does not clear current B state.

steps: Render session_a mail
Current request returns unauthenticated
scenarios.expect: Clear sensitive state, abort outstanding requests, show session-unavailable UI.

steps: Send old authorization version
Return context_changed
Re-bootstrap exactly once
scenarios.expect: No old data retained; repeated mismatch requires explicit retry.

steps: Request a scoped page with expired/mismatched cursor
Return cursor_invalid
Retry first page once retaining filter
scenarios.expect: No repeated recovery loop; no fabricated offset.

steps: Request nonexistent thread
Request inaccessible thread
scenarios.expect: Identical status/code/message and UI; no foreign content.

steps: Return malformed/wrong-content-type/oversized/redirected response or exceed timeout
scenarios.expect: Deliberate bounded client error, no fallback to fixtures and no partial data.

steps: Render thread_hostile_plaintext
scenarios.expect: Inert visible strings; no script, HTML, Markdown, autolink, image or attachment load.

steps: Load summary continuation
Load message continuation in selected thread
scenarios.expect: Independent scoped cursors; detail continuation does not replace list cursor.

steps: Load production entrypoint
Make API unavailable
scenarios.expect: Unavailable UI; no fixture modules/data in bundle or fixture fallback.

cd_setup.description: Separate synthetic C/D state; does not modify original A/B examples. Provision through guarded fixture routines, never infer permissions from IDs or email addresses.

steps: Use a syntactically valid C/D request with locally revoked session and stale context.
cd_scenarios.expect: 401 unauthenticated, never 409 or protected payload; no write.

steps: Use valid session with stale context.
Separately use current context with missing/wrong Origin or session CSRF, including a lifecycle challenge.
cd_scenarios.expect: Stale context gives 409 context_changed; invalid write proof gives 400 request_invalid; no mutation or ledger.

steps: Request absent, foreign-organization, foreign-author draft and inaccessible private mailbox resources.
Try mismatched mailbox/thread IDs and membership targets outside the selected organization.
cd_scenarios.expect: 404 not_available with exactly This item is unavailable.; no distinguishing identity, version, subject or snippet.

steps: Repeat query names with equal/different values or percent-encoded aliases; use bracket arrays.
Send duplicate JSON keys at nested Address/capabilities depth, unknown fields, malformed UTF-8, malformed UUID, U+0000 or unpaired surrogate.
cd_scenarios.expect: 400 request_invalid before merge or mutation; no actor/org/capability supplied in place of server authority.

steps: Timeout Auth before transaction, SQL lock, or complete request serialization.
Separately throttle a request.
cd_scenarios.expect: Bounded 503 temporarily_unavailable or 429 rate_limited, no mail content or claimed not-performed outcome; retain draft buffer and operation ID.

steps: Barrier a protected read before/after snapshot S and commit a guarded membership revocation.
Race the corresponding write with revocation using fixed session/generation/business lock order.
cd_scenarios.expect: Before-S revocation is observed; after-S at most one complete old snapshot within 10 seconds; write either commits before guarded revocation or rechecks new authority.

steps: PUT cd_requests.draft_create_empty at a fresh own UUID.
GET own draft and list own summaries.
cd_scenarios.expect: 200 draft_create_applied version 1; exact empty fields persist; no sending or implicit read-state change.

steps: Apply create operation A but lose its response.
Apply operation B at expected_version 1.
Retry exact A and GET operation A.
cd_scenarios.expect: Retry A is original draft_create_applied version 1; operation lookup is operation_a_after_b_or_consumption; current draft remains B version 2.

steps: Start from an already consumed reserved-state fixture with a prior applied A ledger.
Retry exact A, then try a new operation against that draft.
cd_scenarios.expect: A still returns its original editable version 1 result; new operation returns 409 draft_consumed with recorded metadata; BE-02 exposes no consume action.

steps: Save with stale expected_version under a fresh operation ID.
Change the current draft through another valid operation.
Retry exact conflicted operation and look it up.
cd_scenarios.expect: 409 draft_conflict replays; lookup reports the originally recorded current_version/state, not new content or current versions.

steps: Use expected_version 1 for an absent own draft with a new operation ID.
Look up that operation.
cd_scenarios.expect: 409 draft_conflict; operation_missing_draft_conflict with current_version 0 and state null; no draft created.

steps: Retry a known operation with changed subject, Address null versus empty value, recipient order, expected version, reply, body, draft or mailbox.
Keep any changed binding currently authorized.
cd_scenarios.expect: 409 operation_mismatch; original ledger/draft unchanged; object-key order and UUID case alone do not change digest.

steps: Submit identical operation and payload concurrently from two processes.
cd_scenarios.expect: Both terminal responses converge on one original applied result; one draft increment and one actor/org/operation ledger row.

steps: Submit two different payloads under one actor/org/operation ID concurrently.
cd_scenarios.expect: At most one terminal record wins; authorized other request gets 409 operation_mismatch, never a second save.

steps: Crash/roll back before draft plus ledger commit.
Separately drop connection immediately after commit.
cd_scenarios.expect: Rollback leaves neither mutation nor terminal ledger; post-commit retry reconciles original outcome; network failure alone establishes neither case.

steps: Lookup an unknown operation before an in-flight create commits.
Then allow create to commit and repeat lookup.
cd_scenarios.expect: First authorized result may be unknown, second applied; unknown never proves not performed and does not trigger a new operation or send.

steps: Lookup at recorded_at + 7 days minus one microsecond, then exactly +7 days.
Repeat exact PUT after expiry and restart ledger cleanup.
cd_scenarios.expect: Before boundary original detail; at/after boundary expired; PUT 409 operation_mismatch; compacted binding/digest tombstone survives with no BE-02 purge or reexecution.

steps: Revoke compose or organization/mailbox access after a successful save.
Retry or look up original operation.
cd_scenarios.expect: Current authority checked first; stale valid context 409, current inaccessible scope 404, revoked session 401; ledger success does not restore access.

steps: Save non-null reply in same readable mailbox, then foreign/other-mailbox reply.
Exercise cd_boundary_recipes at/above limits with actual serializer.
cd_scenarios.expect: Valid payload persists exactly; invalid reply generic 404; above limits 400 request_invalid; no invalid terminal record or partial save.

steps: Create equal updated_at values and subjects over 256 code points, including non-BMP characters.
Page with small limit and 256 KiB escaped budget; change a draft between pages.
cd_scenarios.expect: updated_at DESC/id DESC; summaries omit body/recipients and truthfully truncate subject; whole entries/cursor from last included; no cross-page snapshot guarantee, client deduplicates/refetches.

steps: GET thread without read state.
PUT read=true twice, then false.
Observe B list/detail for the same and another actor.
cd_scenarios.expect: GET never writes; true returns version 1 twice; false version 2; actor unread is exact inverse; other actor unaffected.

steps: Serialize opposing valid read booleans.
Try non-reader and body actor_id/read:null.
cd_scenarios.expect: Last committed valid write wins; unauthorized scope 404, invalid closed input 400; no cross-actor state write.

steps: GET initial assignment; assign eligible peer with version 0; replay with current version 1; clear with version 1.
Retry old expected version after a change.
cd_scenarios.expect: Versions 0,1,1,2; no-op preserves timestamp; stale request 409 assignment_conflict even if desired value currently matches.

steps: Try foreign/ineligible target.
Race eligible target revocation against assignment through generation guards.
cd_scenarios.expect: Ineligible target generic 404; assignment commits before revocation or observes new ineligibility; historical stored IDs never grant permission.

steps: POST note_create twice including concurrent identical requests.
GET notes.
cd_scenarios.expect: 201 then 200 same id/author/content/version 1/created_at; exactly one immutable note.

steps: Reuse own visible note ID with different body or accessible thread binding.
Reuse another author's or hidden note ID.
cd_scenarios.expect: Own visible mismatch 409 operation_mismatch; other-author/hidden ID generic 404; no changes.

steps: Render cd_examples.notes literally.
Use empty body, 4096/4097 code points, unknown fields and bytes above request budget.
cd_scenarios.expect: No HTML/Markdown/autolink or network fetch; empty/oversize/unknown input 400; exact 4096 code points fits configured request budget even worst escaping.

steps: List multiple notes with equal created_at and enough notes to exceed 256 KiB after escaping.
cd_scenarios.expect: created_at ASC/id ASC; at most 50 whole notes; progress cursor from last included row; no skipped note, unbounded total or partial JSON.

steps: List as current manager, add current-org explicit reader with returned revision, PUT same flags with current revision, DELETE with current revision.
cd_scenarios.expect: Mailbox-wide revision increments once per stored change, no-op preserves revision; affected generations advance; deleting explicit shared membership may leave shared read.

steps: Two current managers concurrently attempt to demote/delete themselves at the same mailbox revision.
Retry after conflict with latest revision.
cd_scenarios.expect: At most one initial change; no committed result removes the last current manager; conflicts are 409 membership_conflict unless session/context/authority invalidation takes precedence.

steps: List or mutate as non-manager.
As manager target a user outside current organization or inject read/role/actor fields.
cd_scenarios.expect: Non-manager/foreign target generic 404; unknown fields 400; no implicit provisioning or organization directory.

steps: DELETE an absent explicit current-org member at current mailbox revision, then at stale revision.
Change another member between list pages.
cd_scenarios.expect: Current absent delete is no-op with null member; stale version 409 membership_conflict; stale membership cursor 400 cursor_invalid after current auth/context checks.

steps: Search hostile plaintext present in authorized and foreign/private unreadable messages.
Restrict to authorized mailbox, then inaccessible mailbox.
cd_scenarios.expect: Only authorized unchanged ThreadSummary entries, one per thread, no counts/body/highlights; inaccessible requested mailbox generic 404; rendering performs no fetch.

steps: Search literal percent, underscore, backslash, apostrophe and mixed-case substring.
Try missing/empty/whitespace-only/257-code-point/duplicate q or limit 0/51.
cd_scenarios.expect: Metacharacters never alter query structure or act as wildcards; valid literal search succeeds; invalid boundaries 400 request_invalid.

steps: Search threads with equal and null last_message_at; page at max 50 and 256 KiB.
Reuse cursor with changed q/mailbox/limit/actor/context/authorization generation or after expiry.
cd_scenarios.expect: last_message_at DESC NULLS LAST/id DESC; cursor bound to exact filters and scope; invalid cursor 400 after higher-priority current auth/context checks; no data from old scope.

steps: Perform read-state/assignment/membership no-op at maximum revision with matching precondition where required.
Attempt a changing write at maximum revision.
cd_scenarios.expect: No-op returns existing revision; changing write 503 temporarily_unavailable before mutation, never integer wrap; a draft save always changes revision.

cd_boundary_recipes.expect: Valid field lengths; serialized UTF-8 JSON <=1048576 bytes must save.

cd_boundary_recipes.recipe: Use legal JSON whitespace after the value to make exactly 1048576 raw UTF-8 bytes, then 1048577 bytes; no Content-Encoding.
cd_boundary_recipes.expect: Exact budget accepted; one byte above is 400 request_invalid; measure raw received bytes, not parsed object size.
Build decoded control characters, JSON-escape them; legal request <=1 MiB and complete DraftResponse <=2 MiB without truncation. U+0000 remains forbidden.
4096 code points accepted, 4097 rejected; do not count UTF-16 code units.
Actual JSON response note <=65536 bytes; a 50-note list shrinks below 262144 bytes using whole entries.

cd_boundary_recipes.recipe: q is 256 repeated U+1F4E8 code points, then 257; decode percent-encoding once before counting.
cd_boundary_recipes.expect: 256 accepted, 257 gives 400; no Unicode normalization changes q or cursor binding.

cd_boundary_recipes.recipe: Use expected version 2147483647, then 2147483648, then negative/fractional/string values; maximum stored state has a separate valid fixture.
cd_boundary_recipes.expect: Out-of-range/type-invalid values 400; correct maximum changing write 503; no-op at maximum remains valid.
